summary: HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of common shares via subscription agreements at $26.93 per share (total ~$19.54M), monthly distribution declarations, and its April 30, 2026 NAV ($26.93/share, aggregate NAV $1.34B). The sales are exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S. This is a normal continuous offering update by a closed-end fund, not a transformative special situation. There is no merger, tender, activist, or restructuring—simply periodic disclosure of monthly issuance, NAV, and distributions. No deal terms apply.
